clue.text: Biblical character, one consumed with doubt

that Pharisee came secretly and questioned how a man could be born again, a byword for the timid, doubting follower

explanation.definitionFit: The Pharisee of John 3 is both a figure of scripture and the classic hesitant, questioning seeker.

clue.text: Frosty waitress in old corner house

explanation.walkthrough: Lyons Corner Houses were large London cafés of the early twentieth century.

clue.text: Christian pioneer permits one to convert

clue.text: Transport for fat cats

clue.text: Time spent between different termini?

clue.text: Rate to appear without a wedding garment?

clue.text: Tie setter displayed in a fashionable area

clue.text: Like words from fluent lip

clue.text: Plant undifferentiated, so all-in

clue.text: Some anger about an organ corresponding to another
